data.title: 卡莲 · 圣痕发作的拥抱索温
data.description: 【卡莲 · 圣痕发作的拥抱索温】教会昏暗静谧的忏悔室内，卡莲因圣痕共鸣引发剧烈的体温骤降与高烧。她娇小的身躯蜷缩在长木椅上微微发颤，双手无力地揪住你的衣襟，整个人被你紧紧揽入怀中取暖。原本苍白的双颊泛起异样的潮红，琥珀色眼眸水润迷离，嘴唇紧咬却忍不住发出微弱的呢喃——「身体……好冷……但是，被你抱住的地方……又烫得像要烧融了一样……」
data.location: 幽暗狭窄、烛光摇曳的教会私密忏悔室
data.action: 蜷缩在怀中双手紧揪对方衣襟索取体温，双颊泛着高烧潮红，眼神水润迷乱
data.lighting: 忏悔室单盏微弱烛台的暖橙光泽
data.camera: close-up, eye level, face and hands on a clothed supporting shoulder
data.promptProse: Curled on the wooden confession-booth bench, Caren Hortensia holds the edge of the viewer's coat near its collar with both weak hands while the clothed shoulder supports her. Her black-and-white clerical vestment stays in place, and her fever-flushed face and amber-yellow eyes remain the close view's focus. Only that supporting shoulder enters the frame. The bench back overlaps a carved partition; a narrow opening beyond it shows the darker church aisle. The single existing candle warms her cheek, knuckles and white sleeve edge, leaving a small hand shadow on the coat. Softer wood reflection keeps the shaded side of her face readable while the partition recesses remain dark.
